title: Deeper/broader ACadRust 0.6.5 tag and issue-state refresh
mode: primary-source web research and local plan reconciliation
scope: Refresh the ACadRust comparator from the previously reviewed 0.6.4 release to the current 0.6.5 tag
Check current peer issue reports for AC1014 producer compatibility, Binary DXF width/framing, owner disposition, and bounded record behavior
Separate same-codec roundtrip coverage, release-note claims, downstream consumers, and independent semantic/native evidence
Update implementation readiness without adding per-slice peer runs or validation cost

method.kind: Read-only review of project-owned release, issue, source, and test pages; reconciled against current plan owners
method.limitations: The AC1014 issue page body could not be retrieved; only its visible issue-index title was used. Public release/source/issue pages are mutable unless pinned. The peer's private customer corpus was unavailable. No peer behavior was reproduced, and no result is attributed to libdxfrw. ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte-layout questions.

sources.revision: v0.6.5; release page displays abbreviated source 289a616
sources.observation: Release page claims DXF/DWG support through modern versions including a new AC1009/R12 route, reports crate tests and WebAssembly/package checks, and says tests requiring unavailable external DWG/SAT files are ignored. The preceding v0.6.4 release separately reports BricsCAD V20 validation on 18/20 generated files; the v0.6.5 release notes do not attribute that result to v0.6.5.
sources.limits: Full source SHA and registry archive checksum were not resolved. Project claims are not a per-operation support matrix or independent acceptance result.

sources.revision: Issue index reviewed 2026-10-20; issue body fetch returned cache miss
sources.observation: Visible title reports an IntelliCAD-written AC1014/R14 DWG parse failure with truncation near bit 3400.
sources.limits: No issue body, file hash, producer build, expected object inventory, grammar trace, or resolution state was verified. This is a compatibility lead only.

sources.observation: Reporter describes fixed-width Binary DXF output mismatches at 60 call sites across 15 group codes; the issue says the peer's own reader accepts the output. It separately reports an embedded-NUL string framing case. The v0.6.5 release notes mention generic binary numeric/string output corrections but do not identify this issue or a reporter retest.
sources.limits: No peer binary was built or run and no issue source file was downloaded. The report is not evidence of a libdxfrw defect or a verified 0.6.5 fault.

sources.observation: Report concerns orphaned entities being moved into model space. The v0.6.5 release notes state that orphaned geometry is kept out of model space.
sources.limits: The reporter's private corpus was unavailable and no reporter confirmation against v0.6.5 was visible.

sources.observation: Reporter states that 70 of 351 private AC1032 drawings failed under 0.6.4 but opened in 0.6.3, mostly at MLeader context records. The v0.6.5 release notes describe preservation of bounded auxiliary DWG objects after decode failures.
sources.limits: The private corpus was unavailable; no retest against v0.6.5 was found. Release-note wording is not proof of resolution or a format rule.

sources.revision: Mutable main source page reviewed 2026-10-20; not bound to v0.6.5 tag
sources.observation: The test source describes same-codec read/write and double-roundtrip checks. It includes fabricated SAB framing and a generated planar body checked after the same library's DWG write/read path.
sources.limits: Useful for internal integrity regressions, but not an external B-rep kernel, independent reader, native CAD acceptance, or exact tagged-release test manifest.

sources.revision: Existing plan-pinned app/repository lineage; current release executable not run
sources.observation: OpenCADStudio and already inventoried wrappers/forks use ACadRust or an ACadRust-derived codec. They may expose separate app rendering/behavior but do not constitute additional independent DWG parser implementations.
sources.limits: No new app build, release binary, codec pin, or runtime was evaluated in this pass.
